El formato redondo elegido para ella, como hemos comentado, favorece un punto dulce amplio y hace que nos perdone bastante bien cuando no golpeamos exactamente por el centro.

products.title: Vibora Titan 2025 - Vibora
products.description:
The Víbora Titan 2025 is the top-of-the-range model from the Spanish firm Víbora Pádel. With a very attractive design and high quality materials, for a 5-star padel racket that will leave you impressed. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

This is the most exclusive Viper racket from the Viper firm, with quality materials and impressive performance on the court.

Buy the top-of-the-range racket from the Víbora brand in our padel store and play like a professional, with the new Víbora Titan 2025 model.

PLAYER TYPE

Indicated for advanced or professional players who want a versatile padel racket of high quality and durability.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The Víbora Titan 2025 is made with 12k three-layer carbon, which provides great rigidity when hitting, to have more power in defining hits and greater control in defensive hits. 

Its multi-eva core, this lamination of rubber of different hardness, improves the sensation of hitting and gives greater stability to the structure of the racket.

The Frame is made entirely of carbon for greater durability and consistency.

Its format is hybrid, so it provides a medium balance, with very good manageability.

It incorporates an anti-vibrator in the heart of the racket, to reduce vibrations in the game and avoid unnecessary injuries.

It also incorporates plane roughness to improve in-game effects.

BLADE DESIGN

The design of the new Víbora Titan 2025 is very attractive and elegant in white, gold and black colors, for players who like to play with a top-of-the-range Víbora racket model.

PLAY STYLE

The playing style of the Víbora Titan 2025 is versatile, ideal for players who want an all-terrain racket that gives them very good power but with a great feeling of control.
